lines: 3P Salida Pole Pedal Paddle - Get Multi-Disciplinated - Registration/Schedule
There’s a $10 fee for ACA insurance that will be added to your registration, unless you have an ACA
All registration is online. No registration will be offered after Tuesday 4/9/24.
4/13/24 3-6 pm: Participant check-in and bib pick-up will take place at the riverside patio behind A
4/13/24 5 pm, 6pm: There will be a competitor meeting at 5 pm and 6 pm next to the registration tent
4/14/24 9am: 3P volunteers will be on hand to watch bikes at Transition 1, Fooses Creek trailhead pa
4/14/24 10am: Race start! Skiers leave Monarch Pass parking lot in one-minute waves of 10-15 skiers.
4/14/24 1pm – 5pm: Your registration includes a meal and beer at the afterparty at Highside Bar and
